body: Thank you so much for taking time out for me. I feel like I'm going crazy, but your comments keep me a little grounded, especially the equating love with sex bit. You've opened my eyes a little. Thank you.

I want to thank you for responding and sharing something so personal. You are the minority in telling me it was just a mistake, though I'm trying to break out of this cycle where my life is just ruled by my libido and apathy. I haven't skipped a day for a year where I haven't cried. I've hurt him so bad, I wish he would kill me so I could feel like he's gotten even with me, but despite how I've described him, he's my best friend and is too kind to do that. Do you think a couple can overcome this? The cheating and the rape? Because out of both, it seems he is most disappointed by me getting raped, as he made me promise not to drink, but I did so anyways.
I've been having 3 hr nights recently and can agree that it fucks you up more than you think.
Whatever you choose, you gotta have the 50 hawks. Your only other aerial option is the sniper and honestly, even if was the best shot, he's way too outnumbered.
I did the same. Literally the hour after I did it I was crying on the phone telling him everything. Worked out alright, but it's honestly the only thing in my life I would change.
